name: WF-10: AgriSensa RAG Knowledge Ingestion Pipeline

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO knowledge_ingestion_log (
    document_title,
    source_type,
    total_chunks,
    total_characters,
    collection_name,
    ingestion_status,
    metadata
) VALUES (
    '{{ $json.document_title }}',
    '{{ $json.source_type }}',
    {{ $json.total_chunks }},
    {{ $json.total_characters }},
    'agrisensa_kb',
    'completed',
    '{{ JSON.stringify({ summary: $json.ai_summary, metrics: $json.extracted_metrics }) }}'::jsonb
) RETURNING id, created_at;

meta.description: WF-10: Automated RAG Knowledge Ingestion Pipeline — Parse PDF/Doc, Chunk Semantic Texts, and Store into Vector Knowledge Base
